Thailand. From September 15, visa-free stay is 30 days again, not 60

The special 60-day regime that was granted to citizens of about 93 countries since July 2024 is being cancelled. The new rules will start from September 15, 2026. Until this date, 60 days are still given at the border.

What's changing:
• Most countries, including Russia, USA, EU, UK, Australia - visa-free stay of 30 days.
• Seychelles and Mauritius - 15 days.
• Visa on Arrival is being limited; countries like Azerbaijan, Belarus, Serbia remain on the list.
• Those already in the country on a 60-day stamp can complete their stay. There is no retroactive effect.
• DTV, LTR, Privilege, work, pension - remain unchanged.

Why: in May, the government decided to close the gap for visa-runners, nominal tourists, and those living in the country for months. The usual package vacation (~9 days) is almost unaffected.
For Russians, the visa-free stay is not being canceled - they are simply returning to the old 30-day limit under a bilateral agreement.

⚠️ Bitcoin mining divide pushes Luke Dashjr out of OCEAN 

📣 OCEAN co-founder Luke Dashjr left the Bitcoin mining pool on Aug. 29 after reaching a mutual separation agreement with its parent company, Mummolin Inc. He resigned as chairman, chief technology officer and director. OCEAN and Dashjr attributed the separation to “different visions for the future of Bitcoin mining following the recent protocol developments.” The statement did not identify the developments or explain the areas of disagreement.

📊 The wording therefore does not confirm whether a single Bitcoin protocol proposal caused the split. Dashjr has participated in public debates about transaction policies, mining decentralization and alternative Bitcoin software. Connecting the departure to any particular dispute would require further confirmation from the parties. Dashjr had already stepped back from his OCEAN responsibilities earlier in August. His permanent departure now removes him from the company’s leadership and ownership structure.

🌐 The company did not announce a replacement chairman or chief technology officer. It also provided no details about how Dashjr’s former technical responsibilities will be distributed. Dashjr plans to create a new venture called CONVOY. The joint statement said the project would continue his mission of decentralizing Bitcoin mining.

Trump called the Iran war an “excursion” that would last a few weeks. Six months later, the mission has become a global holding pattern with no exit, no agreed definition of victory and a shipping crisis that was not even on the original list of objectives.

The White House began by talking about Iran’s nuclear program, missile forces and regime change. It now treats reopening the Strait of Hormuz as a central war aim. 

Before the war, about one-fifth of global oil moved through the strait. Iran turned that sea lane into leverage, sending fuel and fertilizer costs higher from the Gulf to the supermarket shelf.

The war also pulled U.S. weapons from the places Washington says matter most. Patriot, THAAD and other missile-defense systems moved from Europe and Asia to the Middle East. 

The U.S. canceled a major amphibious exercise with South Korea. Taiwan expects significant delays in Patriot deliveries. European Command has reportedly revised operational plans as interceptor and ATACMS stocks reached “beyond critical” levels.

Trump wanted a short demonstration of force. He got a six-month supply-chain audit of American power.

The war did not only weaken Iran. It taught every U.S. ally how long Washington’s warehouse stays full when three crises arrive at once.
